findings.quote_bytes: survivors of D2 are ranked by (i) ancestry-distance tier (min measured |rho| descending, applied mechanically), then (ii) P0 fired-population size descending, then (iii) lexicographic config ID; the top <= 3 become scored candidates.
findings.why_wrong: The selection key contradicts its own label and the plan's novelty doctrine. The R0 veto binds on the MAXIMUM measured |rho| across the shadow inventory (per-leg AND pooled; any measurement > 0.30 kills, lines 271-279). Survivors therefore all sit at or under 0.30 on their worst shadow. Ranking them by MIN measured |rho| DESCENDING prefers the survivors whose least-correlated shadow relation is highest — i.e., the configurations MOST entangled with killed ancestry, the ones nearest the veto line — which is the exact opposite of 'ancestry-distance' as the plan itself uses the concept everywhere else (§2: killed-ancestry rho is disqualifying, re-admission of the 0.230 class is a disclosed concession, not a preference; NG7 §2: 'Zero ledger ancestry on this observable' is the novelty claim). Every parse of 'min measured |rho| descending' (min across shadows, or min across per-leg/pooled measurements) selects the most ancestry-adjacent arm. This tier decides which <= 3 of up to 80 configurations consume the cycle's ENTIRE scored budget; executed as written it systematically spends cells on the arms most likely to be reduced at R4/R5/R6 and can flip the terminal outcome (REJECT_ALL vs SURVIVORS_UNDER_RELAXED_BATTERY) for selection-engineered reasons. Secondary defect in the same block: tier (ii) cites the 'P0 fired-population size', but the fired census is measured at D2 (§7), not P0 — the frozen contract's own phase labels disagree. Load-bearing, budget-determining, and would freeze the contradiction into the hashed D1 manifest.
findings.required_remediation: Rewrite tier (i) with one explicitly stated, direction-correct metric BEFORE D1 — e.g. 'max-over-shadows |rho| ascending (greatest minimum distance from every shadow)', or another novelty metric stated in full — fix the tier-(ii) phase label to the D2 fired census, and carry the corrected order verbatim into the D1 manifest freeze. Then re-audit with a NEW fresh-context A7.

findings.quote_bytes: is charged exactly one conservative worst-night band of 1.7 bps (NG7-A4's own worst-differential arithmetic for NZD-USD, ~5.1 bps over 3 nights), marked STATED-CONSERVATIVE
findings.why_wrong: The resolution of the NG6/NG7 F4 fail-closed class is SOUND in structure (see audit_items_adjudicated.item_1) but the derivation is an extrapolation beyond the committed bytes: NG7 §4 F4 states '~5.1 bps over 3 nights' — an approximate, 3-night-CUMULATIVE, NZD-USD-only hurdle illustration ('can flip a sign vs a 3.0 bps hurdle'), not a full-sample worst-SINGLE-night census and not an all-legs bound. (a) A 3-night average does not bound the single worst night (5.1 over 3 nights is compatible with a worst night > 1.7). (b) NZD-USD-worst is generalized to all five legs without a committed per-leg differential census (none can exist — NG6 F4: overnight swap points UNMEASURABLE from TD). The band therefore satisfies NG6's law as citable-and-derived (5.1/3 = 1.7 exactly; 'no invented numbers' met), but its 'worst-night, all-legs' characterization is an inference the plan must carry as a disclosed caveat, not silently as fact.
findings.required_remediation: In the D1 manifest freeze, print the derivation verbatim (source bytes: NG7 §4 F4 '~5.1 bps over 3 nights'; arithmetic 5.1/3 = 1.7) plus the two caveats (3-night-cumulative source figure; single-night maxima may exceed the nightly average; NZD-USD named worst by NG7-A4 without a per-leg census). Keep the STATED-CONSERVATIVE label and stress-2.0-primary (operative 3.4 bps/night) attached to the band in every result artifact, as §4 already drafts.

findings.quote_bytes: (absence) — §6 control inventory and §5 selection carry no self-subsumption law; predecessor NG7 §5 line: 'self-subsumption |rho| <= 0.98 vs anchor (P-20)'

findings.quote_bytes: state on completed bar t; entry at bar t+1 open, exit at bar t+1 close — SINGLE-BAR HOLD LAW (§1); ... no same-bar signal-fill
findings.why_wrong: The OPEN-GAP state (gap of bar t+1's open vs prior close vs a threshold) is knowable only AT bar t+1's open, contradicting F3's blanket 'state on completed bar t', and the forced fill at that same open is literally a same-bar signal-fill. There is no look-ahead (the open is the first bookable price and the fill price itself), but a frozen execution law that one of five families cannot satisfy forces implementer improvisation — exactly what frozen contracts must not require.
findings.required_remediation: Add an explicit F3/D1 exception declaring OPEN-GAP's state timing (state formed from close(t) and open(t+1), filled at open(t+1)) and the forced open fill, frozen before scoring.

audit_items_adjudicated.item_1_f4_financing_resolution: SOUND_IN_STRUCTURE, MEDIUM caveat filed (F-2). (a) No silent zero: the charge is named, nonzero, preregistered, always strictly negative, and charged uniformly regardless of sign, so no leg can ever benefit from an assumed favourable differential; NG6 F4's 'CITABLE, preregistered conservative band (source quoted bytes; no invented numbers)' branch is satisfied by derivation (NG7 §4 F4 committed bytes: '~5.1 bps over 3 nights'; 5.1/3 = 1.7), so the NOT_MEASURABLE fail-closed branch — which fires only when NO citable band exists at the D1 freeze — is not triggered. (b) Not a tautological dual-books: financed book = price book + uniform negative charge, so the books genuinely differ on every arm and sign inversion occurs exactly when a price edge is smaller than the charge — real discriminative power, fail-closed, with a dedicated degenerate M0 fixture (§9). (c) Single-session law is construction-complete: entry bar t+1 open to exit bar t+1 close crosses exactly one rollover, so exactly one night band is the correct charge; no grid family requires a multi-session hold (OPEN-GAP timing exception is F-7, not a hold violation). (d) Understatement direction: theoretically possible only where a single night's true |differential| exceeds 1.7 bps/night for a short-carry position; with stress-2.0 PRIMARY the operative band is 3.4 bps/night (~12.4%/yr), which dominates any realized G10 central-bank differential in the 2007-2026 window per public history, and the uniform-charge construction can never ADD P&L. Residual gap documented as F-2. Round-trip stress arithmetic verified: 2 x 1.5 x 2.0 + 1.7 x 2.0 = 9.4 bps; §8 'charged once per fill / once per session' is consistent with the single-session law.
